artifacts.summary: 7-phase, 5-wave, 5.25-hour plan deleting the three lifecycle command files and de-registering them from manifest.json in one atomic commit, reconciling merge-sources/claudemd.md end to end, retargeting six index-entries.json load_when bindings (three would otherwise become unreachable), retiring three vacuous test guards, pruning stale deploy artifacts, and inventorying the ~76-file out-of-scope reference surface.

memory_candidates.content: When deleting a command/skill/agent file from the agent-system source store, four companion edits are structurally required and are not found by a literal-name grep for the file's own name: (1) the extension manifest.json provides.* array entry, which check-extension-docs.sh fails on as 'manifest entry missing on disk' -- this makes manifest edit + file deletion one indivisible atomic commit, never two; (2) index-entries.json load_when.commands bindings, where any context file left with an EMPTY trigger array becomes silently unreachable -- enumerate every binding and assert a surviving trigger per entry, adding the replacement entry point where the array would empty; (3) static-guard test cases that reference the deleted path and degrade to a SKIPPED branch rather than failing, becoming permanently vacuous while still reporting as run; (4) stale deployed copies under .claude/, which a default deploy-headless.sh resync copies-without-pruning, tripping the deployed-orphan lint rule -- only --wipe prunes. Run audit-deletion-references.sh for the glob/pattern-prose and reachability axes that literal grep structurally cannot reach.
